examples.title: Color-correct a premultiplied element safely
examples.code:
# Build a self-contained Unpremult -> Grade -> Premult workflow.
element = nuke.createNode("ColorWheel")
element.setName("Premultiplied_element")

unpremult = nuke.createNode("Unpremult")
unpremult.setInput(0, element)
unpremult["channels"].setValue("rgb")
unpremult["alpha"].setValue("alpha")

# Correct unassociated RGB so soft edges receive the same correction as solid pixels.
grade = nuke.createNode("Grade")
grade.setInput(0, unpremult)
grade["channels"].setValue("rgb")
grade["multiply"].setValue(1.15)
grade["gamma"].setValue(0.95)

# Restore premultiplication before compositing the element over another image.
premult = nuke.createNode("Premult")
premult.setInput(0, grade)
premult["channels"].setValue("rgb")
premult["alpha"].setValue("alpha")
